title: What does this print? (share late)
statement:
What does this program print?

```python
import numpy as np

delays = np.array([12, -3, 25, 4, 0, 18, 7, -1, 31, 9])
late = delays[delays > [$c.t]]
print(len(late) / len(delays))
```

[______]{a}
hints: `delays > [$c.t]` is True where the delay is more than [$c.t].
Count the values strictly greater than [$c.t].
Divide that count by 10, the number of delays.
solution: [$c.k] of the 10 delays are greater than [$c.t], so it prints [$c.k]/10 = [$c.v].
